name: Cloudways Velocity

evidence.paas: 03: hosted managed Node.js runtime; Cloudways runs the infrastructure and the customer deploys apps

line: Deploy and manage Node.js apps on Cloudways infrastructure.

free.text: 3-day trial; card requirement and expiry behavior are unpublished

work.math: $20 a month for the advertised Starter base, plus a disk charge for a 25 GB disk, plus backup storage, plus other costs. The full workload total is unknown.
$20 for the Starter base for 730 hours, plus an unknown disk charge for a 25 GB disk, plus backup storage and other costs. The exact hosting charge is not confirmed.
